description: This file defines an abstract event class 'LeaveStatusChange' within the OrangeHRM HR management system. The class encapsulates the context for a leave status change event, including leaves affected, the workflow state machine, and the user performing the action.

classes.name: LeaveStatusChange
classes.description: Abstract class representing a leave status change event, encapsulating affected leaves, workflow state, and performer.

methods.name: getLeaves
methods.description: Returns the array of leaves related to the leave request.

methods.name: getWorkflow
methods.description: Returns the workflow state machine associated with the leave change.

methods.name: getPerformer
methods.description: Returns the user who performed the leave status change.
